mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.max_rate, p.monthly_payment_limit, pr.base_rate FROM product p JOIN product_rate pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_type = 'SAVINGS' AND p.installment_type = 'FREE' AND pr.min_term <= #{termMonths} AND (pr.max_term IS NULL OR pr.max_term >= #{termMonths})
